description: This file contains the implementation of the DefaultIndexProfileManager class, which manages IndexProfile objects including creation, deletion, retrieval, updating, validation, and synchronization within the OrchardCore indexing system.

classes.name: DefaultIndexProfileManager
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IIndexProfileManager, responsible for managing IndexProfile lifecycle operations including creation, deletion, retrieval, updating, validation, and synchronization.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes an IndexProfile, invoking handlers before and after deletion, and returns a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: FindByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an IndexProfile by its ID, loading additional data via handlers if found.

methods.name: FindByNameAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an IndexProfile by its name, loading additional data via handlers if found.

methods.name: FindByNameAndProviderAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an IndexProfile by its name and provider, loading additional data if found.

methods.name: GetByProviderAsync
methods.description: Gets all IndexProfiles for a specific provider, loading data for each.

methods.name: NewAsync
methods.description: Creates a new IndexProfile with specified provider and type, initializing via handlers.

methods.name: PageAsync
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of IndexProfiles based on query context, loading each profile.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates and persists a new IndexProfile, invoking creation handlers.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing IndexProfile with optional data, invoking updating handlers.

methods.name: ValidateAsync
methods.description: Validates an IndexProfile via handlers and returns validation results.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all IndexProfiles, loading each profile.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves IndexProfiles filtered by provider and type, loading each profile.

methods.name: LoadAsync
methods.description: Internal method to load additional data into an IndexProfile via handlers.
